annotation.title_clean: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 of the European Parliament and of the Council laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)
annotation.title_en: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (PE-CONS 24/1/24 REV 1)
annotation.summary_en: The EU Artificial Intelligence Act, the final text approved on 13 June 2024. It sets harmonised, risk-based rules for AI systems: prohibited practices, high-risk requirements, transparency duties, general-purpose AI model obligations, governance and penalties. Safety components of regulated products (machinery, vehicles, medical devices) fall within high-risk rules.
key_provisions_or_claims: Risk-based tiers: prohibited practices, high-risk systems, transparency obligations
High-risk AI that is a safety component of products under Annex I legislation (machinery, medical devices, vehicles) requires third-party conformity assessment
High-risk requirements: risk management, data governance, technical documentation, logging, human oversight, accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity
Obligations for general-purpose AI models, including those with systemic risk
Military, defence and national security uses and pure scientific research are excluded; sandboxes and SME support are provided
